name: Hylsa batch direct reduction at Monterrey
description: Hylsa brought a gas-based batch plant for making direct-reduced iron into operation at Monterrey, Mexico, in December 1957. It supplied iron-bearing feed for the steelmaker’s electric-arc furnaces.

date.basis: Tenova HYL’s December 2015 editorial dates start-up to December 1957; the EPA survey independently supports the year.

events.statement: Hylsa started industrial batch direct reduction at Monterrey to secure iron feed for its electric-arc steelmaking.

evidence.supports: Monterrey, December 1957 and original purpose of securing iron for electric-arc steelmaking.

evidence.locator: HyL Process, process description and Table 6, first Monterrey row
evidence.supports: Batch HyL configuration and plant start year.

earliest_record.rationale: Tenova HYL’s December 2015 editorial dates start-up to December 1957; the EPA survey independently supports the year.

research.note: The scoped record dates Hylsa’s Monterrey achievement. It uses the vendor’s month but makes no global priority claim.
